activity.notes: Mehmed II's second and principal Ottoman reign lasted from 1451 to 1481 and included the conquest of Constantinople in 1453. ATLAS keeps it separate from his first reign because Murad II returned to the throne between 1446 and 1451.

sources.title: The Art of the Ottomans before 1600 — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art gives Mehmed II's reigns as 1444–46 and 1451–81 and discusses his conquest of Constantinople.

sources.title: Muhammad II — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Mehmed II as Ottoman sultan and documents the two separate reign periods.
